entries.en: We found the discontinued lamp at a factory outlet outside town.
entries.zh: 我们在城外一家工厂直销店找到了那款已经停产的灯。

entries.en: The coach valued fair play more than an easy victory.
entries.zh: 教练认为，公平比赛比轻松获胜更重要。

entries.en: One string of fairy lights had tangled around the cardboard decorations on our Christmas tree.
entries.zh: 一串圣诞树小彩灯缠在了我们圣诞树上的纸板装饰物上。

entries.en: The documentary questions the claims made by a self-described faith healer.
entries.zh: 这部纪录片质疑了一名自称信仰疗法治疗者的人所作的宣称。

entries.en: A falling-off in attendance forced the organisers to book a smaller room.
entries.zh: 出席人数减少，迫使组织者改订了一个较小的房间。

entries.en: A false move on the wet rocks nearly sent him into the stream.
entries.zh: 在湿滑岩石上的一次失足，差点让他掉进溪流。

entries.en: The classroom exercise included a false positive to test our interpretation.
entries.zh: 课堂练习中包含一个假阳性结果，用来考查我们的解读能力。

entries.en: The race restarted after a false start in the outside lane.
entries.zh: 外侧跑道上出现抢跑后，比赛重新开始。

entries.en: The fan club collected photographs for a small anniversary exhibition.
entries.zh: 后援会为一个小型周年纪念展收集了照片。

entries.en: Our office fantasy football league sparked more conversation than the lunch menu.
entries.zh: 我们办公室的虚拟足球联赛引发的讨论，比午餐菜单还多。

entries.en: The novel refuses to reduce its stylish heroine to a fashion victim.
entries.zh: 这部小说没有把衣着时髦的女主人公简单描写成一个盲目追潮流的人。

entries.en: She found the feather duster behind a stack of empty picture frames.
entries.zh: 她在一摞空画框后面找到了羽毛掸帚。

entries.en: My feet were aching by the time we reached the village.
entries.zh: 我们走到村子时，我的双脚已经酸痛了。

entries.en: A red felt-tip had leaked inside the pencil case.
entries.zh: 一支红色毡头笔在铅笔盒里漏墨了。

entries.en: He passed me the field-glasses when a deer appeared across the valley.
entries.zh: 山谷对面出现一只鹿时，他把野外双筒望远镜递给了我。

entries.en: The novel presents the siege as a fight to the finish.
entries.zh: 这部小说把那场围城战描写成一场战斗到底的较量。

entries.en: The extra rehearsal gave our inexperienced team a fighting chance.
entries.zh: 额外的一次排练，让我们这支经验不足的队伍仍有一拼的机会。

entries.en: The workshop introduced file-sharing through a folder of sample photographs.
entries.zh: 工作坊用一个样本照片文件夹介绍了文件共享。

entries.en: The case study compares two firms offering different financial services.
entries.zh: 这个案例比较了两家提供不同金融服务的公司。

entries.en: The school invited the fire service to its community information day.
entries.zh: 学校邀请消防部门参加社区信息日活动。

entries.en: The museum's display traces the development of firefighting equipment.
entries.zh: 博物馆的展品展示了消防设备的发展过程。

entries.en: Everyone stayed late to prepare the costumes for the first night.
entries.zh: 为了准备首夜演出的服装，大家都忙到很晚。

entries.en: The fictional agreement gave the tenant first refusal on the shop.
entries.zh: 那份虚构协议给予租户对该店铺的优先取舍权。

entries.en: A patient instructor helped each first-timer adjust the unfamiliar equipment.
entries.zh: 一位耐心的教练帮助每个初学者调整不熟悉的设备。

entries.en: The last fishcake was still warm when we divided the leftovers.
entries.zh: 我们分剩余食物时，最后一块鱼饼还是温的。

entries.en: The classroom example records the delivery van as a fixed asset.
entries.zh: 课堂示例把那辆送货车记作一项固定资产。

entries.en: The costume designer checked the actor's flak jacket before filming the scene.
entries.zh: 拍摄那场戏之前，服装设计师检查了演员的防护背心。

entries.en: An empty flame-thrower stood behind glass in the military museum.
entries.zh: 一具空的火焰喷射器陈列在军事博物馆的玻璃柜后。

entries.en: The novel's flight lieutenant keeps a photograph of home inside his notebook.
entries.zh: 小说中的英国皇家空军上尉把一张家乡照片夹在笔记本里。

entries.en: The lecturer used an imaginary crisis to discuss flight of capital.
entries.zh: 讲师用一场假想危机来讨论资本外逃。

entries.en: The fictional investigation focuses on a missing flight recorder.
entries.zh: 那项虚构调查的重点是一个失踪的飞行记录器。

entries.en: The tide left flotsam and jetsam scattered along the harbour wall.
entries.zh: 潮水退去后，港口堤墙沿线散落着各种漂浮残骸。

entries.en: My aunt joined a flower arranging class at the community hall.
entries.zh: 我的一位阿姨参加了社区礼堂里的插花课。

entries.en: The flying doctor checked the weather before confirming the remote visit.
entries.zh: 那位乘机出诊的医生先查看天气，再确认偏远地区的探访安排。

entries.meaningZh: 焦点讨论小组〔市场研究〕
entries.en: The focus group disagreed about the packaging but liked the smaller size.
entries.zh: 焦点讨论小组对包装意见不一，但喜欢较小的规格。

entries.en: Months of foot-dragging left the community hall without its promised repairs.
entries.zh: 几个月的故意拖延，让社区礼堂一直没有得到承诺的维修。

entries.en: The memoir describes the weekly ritual of filling in the football pools.
entries.zh: 这本回忆录描写了每周填写足球赛果博彩单的固定活动。

entries.en: The forklift truck remained parked while the crew cleared the loading area.
entries.zh: 工作人员清理装货区时，叉车停着没有开动。

entries.en: In the fairy tale, the fortune-teller refuses to predict the child's future.
entries.zh: 童话中，那位占卜者拒绝预测孩子的未来。

entries.en: A missing forward slash prevented the sample path from working.
entries.zh: 少了一个正斜杠，导致那条示例路径无法使用。

entries.en: The receptionist asked whether the departing guest had left a forwarding address.
entries.zh: 接待员问，那位离开的客人是否留下了邮件转交地址。

entries.en: A founder member returned to help organise the club's anniversary dinner.
entries.zh: 一名创始成员回来帮忙筹办俱乐部的周年晚宴。

entries.en: The room's four-poster bed left little space for our suitcases.
entries.zh: 房间里放着四柱帷床，几乎没地方放我们的行李箱。

entries.en: The archive contains letters both supporting and opposing fox-hunting.
entries.zh: 档案中既有支持猎狐的信，也有反对猎狐的信。

entries.en: The novelist researched foxhunting before setting the opening chapter in the countryside.
entries.zh: 小说家先研究了猎狐，再把开篇背景设在乡间。

entries.en: The fictional detective joins the fraud squad halfway through the series.
entries.zh: 剧集进行到一半时，那位虚构侦探加入了反诈骗科。

entries.en: The seminar compared different arguments about the limits of a free market.
entries.zh: 研讨课比较了有关自由市场局限的不同论点。

entries.en: The volunteer showed her free pass at the gallery entrance.
entries.zh: 志愿者在美术馆入口出示了免费通行票。

entries.en: A free-marketeer challenged the proposal during the fictional council debate.
entries.zh: 在那场虚构的议会辩论中，一位自由市场支持者反对了那个提案。

entries.meaningZh: 独立思考者；自由思想家
entries.en: The memoir portrays its author as a stubborn free-thinker.
entries.zh: 这本回忆录把作者描绘成一个固执的独立思考者。

entries.en: The freed prisoners thanked their freer before leaving the courtyard.
entries.zh: 获释的囚犯在离开院子前，向解救他们的人道了谢。

entries.en: The committee welcomed fresh blood after several long-serving members retired.
entries.zh: 几位长期任职的成员退休后，委员会欢迎新成员加入。

entries.meaningZh: 互助组织；互助保险协会
entries.en: The local friendly society helped organise a meeting for its members.
entries.zh: 当地互助组织帮助会员们安排了一次会议。

entries.en: We watched the frogspawn without disturbing the edge of the pond.
entries.zh: 我们观察了蛙卵，没有扰动池塘边缘。

entries.en: She spooned fromage frais into a bowl beside the sliced fruit.
entries.zh: 她把新鲜软奶酪舀进切好的水果旁边的一只碗里。

entries.en: He ordered a fry-up with eggs and ham before the long journey.
entries.zh: 长途旅行前，他点了一份带煎蛋和火腿的煎食餐。

entries.en: The classroom model showed a fuel rod without using any radioactive material.
entries.zh: 课堂模型展示了燃料棒的形状，没有使用任何放射性材料。

entries.en: Their booking included full board, so they ate every meal at the guest house.
entries.zh: 他们的预订包含全膳住宿，因此每餐都在招待所吃。

entries.en: She earned full marks for the clear diagram in her final answer.
entries.zh: 她最终答案中的图示清楚，因此获得了满分。

entries.en: The full-back stayed near the sideline while the forwards moved into position.
entries.zh: 前锋们跑位时，那名后卫待在边线附近。

entries.en: The only full-timer trained the volunteers before the shop opened.
entries.zh: 商店开门前，唯一的全职工作人员培训了志愿者们。

entries.en: The afternoon began with fun and games before the serious rehearsal.
entries.zh: 下午先是一阵欢乐嬉戏，随后才开始认真排练。

entries.en: A worn function key made the old keyboard easy to recognise.
entries.zh: 一个磨损的功能键，让那把旧键盘很容易辨认。

entries.en: The college offered further education to adults returning to study.
entries.zh: 那所学院为重新开始学习的成年人提供继续教育。

entries.en: The guide asked visitors to remain inside the vehicle in the game park.
entries.zh: 导游让游客在野生动物保护区内留在车里。

entries.meaningZh: 禁猎区；野生动物保护区
entries.en: The photographer spent three mornings waiting near the game reserve's entrance.
entries.zh: 摄影师连续三个早晨都在野生动物保护区入口附近等候。

entries.en: The documentary gives survivors of gang rape control over how their stories are told.
entries.zh: 这部纪录片让轮奸幸存者自己决定如何讲述亲身经历。

entries.en: He spent part of his gap year helping restore a community theatre.
entries.zh: 他在间隔年的一段时间里，帮忙修复了一座社区剧院。

entries.en: The garden centre had sold out of the pots we wanted.
entries.zh: 园艺商店里，我们想买的花盆已经售罄了。

entries.en: The novel's manager spends her gardening leave sorting years of personal letters.
entries.zh: 小说中的经理在离职前带薪待职假期间，整理了多年来的私人信件。

entries.en: The old gas fire stood unused beneath a dusty mantelpiece.
entries.zh: 那台旧燃气取暖器放在积灰的壁炉架下，一直没有使用。

entries.en: The club set aside the gate money for repairs to the changing rooms.
entries.zh: 俱乐部把门票收入留出来，用于修理更衣室。

entries.meaningZh: 设门卫的封闭式住宅区
entries.en: The delivery driver waited at the entrance to the gated community.
entries.zh: 送货司机在那个封闭式住宅区的入口等候。

entries.en: The geese crossed the lane before we reached the gate.
entries.zh: 我们走到大门前，那群鹅先横穿了小路。

entries.en: The seminar discussed gene therapy without making claims about a particular treatment.
entries.zh: 研讨课讨论了基因治疗，没有对某项具体治疗作出宣称。

entries.en: She chose general practice after observing doctors in several different specialties.
entries.zh: 在观察过几个不同专科的医生工作后，她选择了全科医疗。

entries.en: The exhibition opened to the general public after a quiet preview.
entries.zh: 一场安静的预展结束后，展览向公众开放。

entries.en: The historical novel describes the confusion caused by a general strike.
entries.zh: 这部历史小说描写了一场总罢工引发的混乱。

entries.en: Our small get-together ended with everyone helping to wash the dishes.
entries.zh: 我们的小聚会以大家一起帮忙洗碗结束。

entries.en: The children asked for a ghost story but kept the lights on.
entries.zh: 孩子们想听鬼故事，却又一直开着灯。

entries.meaningZh: 击败强大对手的人或队伍
entries.en: The village team became an unlikely giant-killer in the cup competition.
entries.zh: 那支乡村球队在杯赛中出人意料地成了强队克星。

entries.meaningZh: 组织内推动行动的核心小组〔英式英语〕
entries.en: A ginger group pressed the association to act on its neglected promises.
entries.zh: 一个核心推动小组催促协会兑现被搁置的承诺。

entries.meaningZh: 女子流行乐队；女子组合
entries.en: The girl band rehearsed upstairs while we prepared the hall below.
entries.zh: 我们在楼下布置礼堂时，女子乐队在楼上排练。

entries.en: We put on our glad rags for the theatre's anniversary party.
entries.zh: 我们穿上盛装，参加了剧院的周年庆祝派对。

entries.en: The essay questions whether instant communication has really created a global village.
entries.zh: 那篇文章质疑，即时通信是否真的创造了一个地球村。

entries.en: A seasoned globe-trotter helped us pack for our first overseas trip.
entries.zh: 一位经验丰富的环球旅行者，帮助我们为第一次海外旅行打包。

entries.en: After years of globe-trotting, she wanted a small home near her family.
entries.zh: 周游世界多年后，她想在家人附近拥有一个小家。

entries.en: The decorator chose gloss paint for the old window frames.
entries.zh: 装修工为那些旧窗框选用了有光泽的涂料。

entries.en: A glow-worm shone near the roots of the fallen tree.
entries.zh: 一只萤火虫在倒树的根部附近发着光。

entries.en: We cancelled the go-karting after the track closed for repairs.
entries.zh: 赛道关闭维修后，我们取消了卡丁车比赛活动。

entries.en: The fictional buyer wanted the shop as a going concern, not an empty building.
entries.zh: 故事中的买家想要的是一家继续营业的店，而不是一栋空楼。

entries.en: The neighbours complained about mysterious goings-on in the empty warehouse.
entries.zh: 邻居们抱怨空仓库里发生的那些神秘事情。

entries.en: She found an expired gold card inside the old travel wallet.
entries.zh: 她在旧旅行钱包里找到了一张过期金卡。

entries.en: The old match report mentions the golden goal rule.
entries.zh: 那份旧比赛报道提到了金球规则。

entries.en: The choir reunited for the school's golden jubilee.
entries.zh: 合唱团为了学校的五十周年纪念而重聚。

entries.meaningZh: 金婚；结婚五十周年纪念
entries.en: Three generations gathered to celebrate the couple's golden wedding.
entries.zh: 三代人聚在一起，庆祝那对夫妇的金婚。

entries.en: The good news arrived just as we were about to leave.
entries.zh: 我们正要离开时，好消息传来了。

entries.en: Through the chair's good offices, the two groups agreed to meet again.
entries.zh: 经过主席斡旋，两个小组同意再次会面。

entries.en: Each visitor received a goody bag containing postcards and a pencil.
entries.zh: 每位访客都领到了一个装着明信片和铅笔的礼包。

entries.en: The sudden cold gave me goose bumps despite my thick jumper.
entries.zh: 尽管穿着厚毛衣，突如其来的寒意还是让我起了鸡皮疙瘩。

entries.en: That eerie melody gave me goose pimples on my arms.
entries.zh: 那段诡异的旋律让我胳膊上起了鸡皮疙瘩。

entries.en: The freight train stopped beside the old grain elevator.
entries.zh: 货运列车停在了那座旧谷物仓库旁。

entries.en: The residents wanted practical answers, not another afternoon of grandstanding.
entries.zh: 居民们想要切实的回答，而不是再看一个下午的作秀。

entries.en: Grata held the folded map while we searched for the street sign.
entries.zh: 我们寻找路牌时，格拉塔拿着折好的地图。

entries.en: The planning exercise asked us to mark the green belt on a map.
entries.zh: 规划练习要求我们在地图上标出绿化带。

entries.meaningZh: 更好的职位或发展机会
entries.en: She left the firm for greener pastures after completing the final project.
entries.zh: 完成最后一个项目后，她离开公司，寻找更好的发展机会。

entries.en: A handwritten greetings card arrived without a return address.
entries.zh: 一张手写贺卡寄来了，上面没有寄件地址。

entries.en: The ground staff covered the pitch before the rain arrived.
entries.zh: 下雨前，球场维护人员把场地盖了起来。

entries.en: He packed the groundbait separately from the rest of his fishing gear.
entries.zh: 他把诱鱼饵与其他渔具分开装好。

entries.en: A corner of the groundcloth had folded beneath the tent.
entries.zh: 防潮地席的一角折到了帐篷下面。

entries.en: The guest house owner left breakfast outside our door.
entries.zh: 招待所老板把早餐放在了我们的房门外。

entries.en: We moved the sewing machine out of the guest room before the visit.
entries.zh: 客人来访前，我们把缝纫机从客房里搬了出去。

entries.en: The guided tour ended in the workshop behind the museum.
entries.zh: 那次导览参观最后在博物馆后面的作坊结束。

entries.en: The actor's exaggerated ha ha ruined the serious scene.
entries.zh: 演员夸张的哈哈笑声破坏了那个严肃的场景。

entries.en: Her old hacking jacket still hung beside the riding boots.
entries.zh: 她那件旧粗呢骑马外套，还挂在马靴旁边。

entries.en: The brochure offered half board, but we preferred to arrange all meals ourselves.
entries.zh: 宣传册提供半膳住宿，但我们更愿意自己安排所有用餐。

entries.meaningZh: 权宜办法；不彻底的措施
entries.en: Replacing only the broken handle felt like a half measure.
entries.zh: 只换掉坏把手，感觉像是个不彻底的办法。

entries.en: The travellers stopped at a halfway house before climbing the final hill.
entries.zh: 旅人们在爬最后一座山之前，先到中途的小客栈歇了脚。

entries.en: The school created a small hall of fame for former pupils' achievements.
entries.zh: 学校设了一个小型名人纪念馆，展示校友的成就。

entries.en: The actor practised smiling beneath his false handlebar moustache.
entries.zh: 那位演员戴着假翘八字胡，练习微笑。

entries.en: His handlebar mustache appeared in every photograph from that summer.
entries.zh: 那个夏天的每张照片里，都能看到他的翘八字胡。

entries.en: The hang-glider remained folded while we waited for the instructor.
entries.zh: 我们等教练时，那架悬挂式滑翔机还折叠着。

entries.en: She watched a demonstration of hang-gliding before deciding whether to join the club.
entries.zh: 她先看了悬挂式滑翔演示，再决定是否加入俱乐部。

entries.en: A small bird perched on the hanging basket outside the kitchen.
entries.zh: 一只小鸟停在厨房外的悬挂花篮上。

entries.en: The committee asked for clear accounts to rule out any hanky-panky.
entries.zh: 委员会要求提供清楚的账目，排除有人捣鬼的可能。

entries.en: We found a happy medium between total silence and constant conversation.
entries.zh: 我们在完全沉默与不停交谈之间找到了适当的平衡。

entries.en: The harbourmaster asked the visitors to wait outside the office.
entries.zh: 港务长让访客在办公室外面等候。

entries.en: The historical novel describes a sentence of hard labour without romanticising it.
entries.zh: 这部历史小说描写了苦役判决，没有将其浪漫化。

entries.en: The fictional party's hard left opposed the compromise presented at the meeting.
entries.zh: 故事中，那个政党的极左派成员反对会上提出的折中方案。

entries.en: She blamed hard luck rather than the team's poor preparation.
entries.zh: 她把失败归咎于运气差，而不是队伍准备不足。

entries.en: The witness proved a hard nut for the fictional detective.
entries.zh: 对那位虚构侦探而言，这名证人很难对付。

entries.en: The village decorated the hall for its harvest festival.
entries.zh: 村里为收获节布置了礼堂。

entries.en: We shared the last portion of hash browns at breakfast.
entries.zh: 早餐时，我们分着吃了最后一份煎土豆饼。

entries.en: She completed a hat-trick of victories at the summer tournament.
entries.zh: 她在夏季锦标赛中取得了三连胜。

entries.en: The seminar examined how a fictional newspaper reported a hate crime.
entries.zh: 研讨课分析了一家虚构报纸如何报道一起仇恨犯罪。

entries.en: The novel gives its have-nots complex lives rather than treating them as a crowd.
entries.zh: 这部小说赋予穷人们复杂的人生，而不是把他们仅仅当作一群人。

entries.en: The essay divides countries into haves and have-nots, then compares their economic concerns.
entries.zh: 这篇文章把各国分为富国与穷国，然后比较它们在经济上各自关心的问题。

entries.en: The head boy checked the hall microphone before the assembly began.
entries.zh: 集会开始前，男生代表检查了礼堂里的麦克风。

entries.en: The head girl welcomed the visitors and handed out programmes.
entries.zh: 女生代表欢迎来宾，并分发了活动单。

entries.en: The referee stopped play after a deliberate head-butt.
entries.zh: 一次故意用头撞人的动作发生后，裁判暂停了比赛。

entries.en: The dancer adjusted her head-dress before stepping onto the stage.
entries.zh: 舞者上台前整理了一下头饰。

entries.en: The health centre receptionist helped him find the correct waiting room.
entries.zh: 保健中心接待员帮助他找到了正确的等候室。

entries.en: The novel's protagonist books a quiet week at a health farm.
entries.zh: 小说主人公在一家健身休养庄预订了一周安静的住宿。

entries.en: The health visitor left a note asking the family to call back.
entries.zh: 卫生访视员留了张便条，请那家人回电话。

entries.en: The magazine's latest heart-throb seemed embarrassed by the attention.
entries.zh: 那位被杂志捧为最新迷恋对象的人，似乎因受到关注而有些尴尬。

entries.en: The memoir criticises the administrator's heavy hand in settling small disputes.
entries.zh: 这本回忆录批评了那位管理者在解决小争端时使用的高压手段。

entries.en: The exhibition traces the town's shift from heavy industry to smaller workshops.
entries.zh: 这场展览追溯了该镇从重工业转向小型作坊的变化。

entries.en: The novel's former hell-raiser now organises quiet concerts at the library.
entries.zh: 小说中，那个从前爱闹事的人，如今在图书馆组织安静的音乐会。

entries.en: Her friends arranged a small hen night at their favourite restaurant.
entries.zh: 她的朋友们在最喜欢的餐厅为她安排了一个小型婚前单身派对。

entries.en: The volunteers wondered whether the generous offer concealed a hidden agenda.
entries.zh: 志愿者们想知道，那个慷慨的提议背后是否藏着别的动机。

entries.en: We moved the high chair away from the edge of the table.
entries.zh: 我们把儿童高脚椅从桌边移开了。

entries.en: The teammates exchanged a high five after finishing the final exercise.
entries.zh: 完成最后一项练习后，队友们击掌庆祝。

entries.en: Her high heels clicked along the empty corridor.
entries.zh: 她的高跟鞋在空荡走廊里敲出清脆的声音。

entries.en: In the fantasy novel, the high priestess refuses the king's invitation.
entries.zh: 奇幻小说中，女大祭司拒绝了国王的邀请。

entries.en: The horse-drawn cart left the high road and followed a narrow lane.
entries.zh: 马车离开大路，转入了一条狭窄的小路。

entries.en: The historical novel follows a merchant ship across the high seas.
entries.zh: 这部历史小说讲述了一艘商船横渡公海的经历。

entries.en: The young high-flier surprised her colleagues by turning down the promotion.
entries.zh: 那位抱负极高的年轻人却拒绝了晋升，令同事们惊讶。

entries.en: The film follows a high-roller who gradually loses his circle of friends.
entries.zh: 这部电影讲述了一个豪赌者逐渐失去朋友圈的经历。

entries.en: An empty hip flask fell from the coat as we unpacked our suitcase.
entries.zh: 我们打开行李箱取东西时，一个空的扁平小酒瓶从外套里掉了出来。

entries.en: The mayor's latest speech returned to his familiar hobby-horse of parking spaces.
entries.zh: 市长最近一次讲话又回到了他反复爱谈的停车位话题。

entries.en: The old holiday camp reopened after volunteers repaired its dining hall.
entries.zh: 志愿者修好了食堂后，那座旧度假营地重新开放了。

entries.en: We spent the summer hols helping our neighbours rebuild their shed.
entries.zh: 暑假里，我们帮邻居重建了他们的棚屋。

entries.en: The home owner showed us the repairs made before the sale.
entries.zh: 房屋业主向我们展示了出售之前做过的维修。

entries.en: The documentary compares home shopping with visits to traditional markets.
entries.zh: 这部纪录片比较了居家购物与逛传统市场这两种方式。

entries.meaningZh: 诚实的中间人；可靠代理人
entries.en: Both groups trusted her to act as an honest broker.
entries.zh: 双方都信任她，愿意让她充当诚实的中间人。

entries.en: The youth club offered horse riding alongside its usual walking trips.
entries.zh: 除了平时的徒步活动，青年俱乐部还提供了骑马活动。

entries.en: The family spent the afternoon watching preparations for the horse show.
entries.zh: 那家人整个下午都在观看马匹评比赛的准备工作。

entries.en: Weeks of horse-trading preceded the fictional coalition agreement.
entries.zh: 那份虚构的联合执政协议达成前，经历了数周的政治讨价还价。

entries.en: Parking quickly became a hot button at the residents' meeting.
entries.zh: 停车问题很快成了居民会议上的敏感话题。

entries.en: She assigned a hot key to the command she used most often.
entries.zh: 她给最常用的命令设置了一个热键。

entries.en: The office introduced hot-desking without removing the quiet meeting rooms.
entries.zh: 办公室实行了办公桌轮用制，但保留了安静的会议室。

entries.en: We spread houmous on warm bread while waiting for the soup.
entries.zh: 等汤时，我们把鹰嘴豆泥抹在温热的面包上。

entries.en: A large house plant hid the cracked paint beside the window.
entries.zh: 一大盆室内植物遮住了窗边开裂的油漆。

entries.en: The shop moved its housewares upstairs to make room for books.
entries.zh: 商店把家用器皿搬到楼上，腾地方放书。

entries.en: The housing association invited residents to discuss repairs to the shared entrance.
entries.zh: 住房协会邀请住户讨论共用入口的维修问题。

entries.en: The fictional character keeps every letter about her housing benefit in a folder.
entries.zh: 那个虚构人物把所有有关住房补助的信都放在一个文件夹里。

entries.en: The editor wanted more human interest without inventing details about the family.
entries.zh: 编辑希望报道更有人情味，但不愿编造那个家庭的细节。

entries.en: The report examines whether the town has enough human resources to staff another school.
entries.zh: 报告考察了这座城镇是否有足够的人力资源为另一所学校配备人员。
